name: Tencent Technology(Shenzhen)Co.,Ltd.
name_zh: 腾讯科技(深圳)有限公司
summary: General business activities: development of computer hardware and software and sale of self-developed software; computer technology and information services; research, development and wholesale of computer hardware; design and development of toys; wholesale and retail of toys and other goods, excluding categories requiring licensing approval; design services for animation and related products; electronic product design; sale of gaming and amusement equipment; domestic trade; import and export of goods and technologies, excluding distribution and goods subject to state-designated, state-controlled or exclusive trading; sale of Class I and Class II medical devices. These activities exclude franchised operations, do not involve special administrative measures for foreign investment access or state-traded goods, and require applications under relevant national rules for goods subject to quotas or licensing. Leasing of non-residential property. Except for projects requiring approval by law, business activities may be carried out independently under the business license. Licensed business activities: sale of Class III medical devices; real estate development and operation. Activities requiring approval by law may commence only after approval by the relevant authorities; the specific activities are subject to the relevant approval documents or licenses.
